title: Ukra's Mythic Horizons
description: A new Modpack made for Fabric, brining all RPG Experience to Fabric and optimization.
body:
# Embark on a new journey beyond the Overworld!
Mythic Horizons is a carefully curated Fabric-based RPG modpack for Minecraft 1.20.1, designed to transform your survival world into a living, breathing adventure. Whether you are playing solo or with friends, this pack offers a perfect balance of exploration, progression, and combat – all while staying lightweight and optimized.

## ✨ Features

**Epic RPG Progression:** Unlock powerful gear, level up your abilities, and discover rare artifacts as you grow stronger.

**Magic & Spells:** Master the arcane arts with mods that introduce spellcasting, mana systems, and magical equipment.

**New Dimensions & Biomes:** Explore breathtaking worlds filled with hidden dungeons, bosses, and treasures waiting to be claimed.

**Enhanced Combat:** Battle challenging mobs and mini-bosses with improved AI and exciting combat mechanics.

**Multiplayer Ready:** Designed for co-op play — grab your friends, form a party, and set out on legendary quests together.

**Optimized for Fabric:** Lightweight and fast, this pack runs smoothly without sacrificing depth or content.

## 🎯 Who Is This For?

- Players who want a vanilla-like RPG experience with added depth.

- Servers looking for a multiplayer-friendly adventure pack.

- Those who love exploration, magic, and progression without unnecessary bloat.

## 🔧 Recommended Setup

- **Loader:** Fabric (latest for 1.20.1)

- **Memory:** At least 6 – 8GB allocated for the best experience.

## 🌍 Join the Adventure

- Grab your sword, prepare your spells, and step into a world of myths, magic, and endless horizons. Your legend starts here.
